v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Deus, mundi ópifex, * pósuit hóminem ut operarétur et custodíret terram, allelúia.
text.en: God, maker of the world, * has stationed man to dress and keep the earth, alleluia.

text.la: Christus, Dei Fílius, * mánibus suis operári dignátus est, allelúia.
text.en: Christ, the Son of God, * deigned to work with his hands, alleluia.

text.la: Artem fabri * fidéliter exércens sanctus Ioseph, labóris mirábile refúlget exémplar, allelúia.
text.en: The craftsman, * holy Joseph, faithfully exercising his trade, shines forth as a marvellous example of work, alleluia.

text.la: Fidélis servus * et prudens, quem constítuit Dóminus super famíliam suam, allelúia.
text.en: Faithful servant, * and prudent, whom the Lord hath appointed over his family, alleluia.

text.la: Ioseph, ópifex sancte, * ópera nostra tuére, allelúia.
text.en: O Joseph, holy workman, * defend our work, alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Caritátem habéte, quod est vínculum perfectiónis, et pax Christi exsúltet in córdibus vestris, et grati estóte.
text.en: Brethren, have charity, which is the bond of perfection, and let the peace of Christ rejoice in your hearts, and be ye thankful.

v.la: Ora pro nobis, sancte Ioseph, allelúia.
v.en: Pray for us, holy Joseph, alleluia.

r.en: Faithful protector of our labours, alleluia.

text.la: Descéndit Iesus * cum María et Ioseph, et venit Názareth, et erat súbditus illis, allelúia.
text.en: Jesus went down * with Mary and Joseph, and came to Nazareth, and was subject to them, alleluia.

text.la: Rerum cónditor Deus, qui legem labóris humáno géneri statuísti: concéde propítius; ut, sancti Ioseph exémplo et patrocínio, ópera perficiámus quæ prǽcipis, et prǽmia consequámur quæ promíttis.
text.en: God, Creator of all things, who didst lay on the human race the law of labour: graciously grant; that by following the example of Saint Joseph and under his patronage, we may carry out the work thou dost command, and obtain the reward thou dost promise.
